newsitem.title: CHINA: China says arrests Taiwan hijacker.
newsitem.headline: China says arrests Taiwan hijacker.

text.p: Chinese authorities have arrested a Taiwan man after he hijacked a Taiwan airliner to China on Monday, the Xinhua news agency said.
"The Taiwanese hijacker, Liu Shan-chung, has been arrested by local police and is being held in Xiamen," Xinhua said.

The Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits, China's semi-official body for handling ties with Taiwan, has informed its Taiwanese counterpart, the Straits Exchange Foundation, of the hijacking, Xinhua said.
All crew members and 150 passengers were safe after the hijacked plane landed at the southeastern Chinese city of Xiamen at 3.36 p.m. (0736 GMT), the agency said.
The Far Eastern Air Transport Boeing 757 was hijacked during a flight from Kaohsiung in southern Taiwan to Taipei, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
The hijacked plane later returned to Taiwan.
